title: PfPassbookReaderOutput
description: LOCKED. Output contract for the Gemini 3.8 Flash EPFO member passbook reader. Account-level fields use the same {value, confidence, raw_text, notes} envelope; each PF account entry carries one row-level confidence for the same reason as bank_statement_schema.json. The reader reports 'status' exactly as printed on the passbook (e.g. a passbook literally marking an account 'Transfer-in-progress' or leaving period_to blank for the current job) -- it must NOT infer 'dormant' itself; that dormancy judgement (no activity for N months, not yet transferred) belongs to rules_engine (Milestone 2).

period_to.description: Normalize to YYYY-MM-DD, or null if the passbook shows no end date (current employer).

status_as_printed.description: Verbatim status text if the passbook prints one (e.g. 'Active', 'Settled', 'Transfer-in-progress'); null if nothing is printed.
